formal_population.selection_rule: include every unique question in validation[512:3610] whose UTF-8 question SHA-256 is absent from the frozen exposure registry; no sampling, replacement or post-score removal
formal_population.count_bound_reason: The 256 spent cases and historical100 are known-disjoint in-pool exclusions; between zero and all434 protected identities may also occur in this validation interval.
formal_population.identity_digest_rule: SHA256(canonical JSON array of dataset_index, question_sha256 and ordered candidate_id_sha256 for every eligible case)

exposure_registry.union_rule: exact set union of the three immutable question-identity sources below

independent_confirmations.split_rule: sort the complete eligible population by SHA256(split_seed:dataset_index:question_sha256), then assign zero-based even positions to split_A and odd positions to split_B
independent_confirmations.coverage_rule: split_A and split_B are disjoint, differ in size by at most one and their union exactly equals the complete formal population

label_boundary.method_key_unseal_rule: both split consensuses must be complete and hash-locked before either method key is opened

blind_review.case_rule: within each split include every question where any of the three frozen Top5 sets differs; review every unique passage in the three-arm Top5 union
blind_review.unchanged_case_rule: questions with identical three-arm Top5 sets contribute exact zero paired deltas and need no duplicated semantic review
blind_review.adjudication: every code disagreement receives a sealed dispute packet and a third blind judgment
blind_review.completion_rule: zero unresolved items and zero uncertain items selected by the quantum arm in either split

metrics.primary: mean useful passages retained per question in Top5
metrics.protected: mean direct-evidence passages retained per question in Top5
secondary: mean semantic points per question where points=useful+direct

paired_statistics.method: question-cluster percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference

all_required: useful mean paired delta is positive and its bootstrap CI95 lower bound is greater than zero
semantic-points mean paired delta is positive and its bootstrap CI95 lower bound is greater than zero
case-level useful wins exceed useful losses
zero unresolved or quantum-selected uncertain review items
all identity, leakage, source, split and replay audits pass
ordinary_utility_l2_gate.promotion_if_passed: L2_reproducible_utility under the project full_real_data_l2 profile
ordinary_utility_l2_gate.stop_if_failed: close this frozen head configuration; no threshold, cohort, split, checkpoint or review-rule rescue

all_required: useful and semantic-points bootstrap CI95 lower bounds are greater than zero
case-level useful wins exceed useful losses
quantum_attribution_continuation_gate.if_passed: authorize a separately preregistered finite-shot implementation and resource audit; do not claim L4 yet
quantum_attribution_continuation_gate.if_failed: ordinary utility may still qualify for L2, but quantum-specific attribution and L4 remain blocked

fatal_stop_conditions: formal population is not the exact complete eligibility closure
any formal question overlaps the frozen exposure registry
a question is dropped, replaced or moved between splits after scoring begins
retrieval, Reader, checkpoint, method source or tie-break identity drifts
any answer, label, review or generation field reaches scoring
method identity is opened before both split consensuses are sealed
score or Top5 replay differs from the frozen artifact

execution_topology.collaborator: materialize the complete NQ/Wiki-DPR cohort using the existing local full-data runtime and upload the frozen artifacts
execution_topology.orchestration_3080ti: verify hashes, store 18083 artifacts, prepare sealed packets and aggregate only
execution_topology.gpu_training_role: after live capacity verification, run one frozen Reader/quantum/classical scoring pass

artifact_policy.github: compact summaries, manifests, hashes, provenance and evidence card only
